description: Verify a sending domain, store the tenant's OWN provider API key encrypted, and bind the sending source to this tenant. Admin-level. Nothing is written unless the DNS verifies. ⚠️ This BINDS an already-enrolled source — it never CREATES one: a mailbox with no capacity row is refused with 409 source_not_enrolled rather than provisioned. ⚠️ It also never promotes a cold domain to 'active'; the returned `state` is reported unchanged so the warm-up ramp still applies. Set enable_tracking=false to bind NO tracking domain — that turns link rewriting OFF (safe: your links are never routed through a host you do not own) at the cost of click/open events. The api_key is never echoed back; only an opaque vault_key_ref is returned.

api_base.description: Provider API base. REQUIRED for an EU Mailgun account ('https://api.eu.mailgun.net') — an EU key against the US host 401s and the source is terminalised.

api_key.description: YOUR provider API key. Stored encrypted; never returned.

brand_id.description: Recorded for admin surfaces. NOT the isolation key — that is always the tenant.

enable_tracking.description: Default true. FALSE binds tracking_domain to NULL, which for a BYO source means link rewriting is OFF — never the platform's tracking host.

mailbox_id.description: The already-enrolled sending source to bind. Must already have a capacity row.

tracking_domain.description: Defaults to 'email.<domain>'. Ignored when enable_tracking is false.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_enroll_domain
